summary: {instructor} asks which licensing provisions draw complaints before preparing a course for dispensers.
realLife: Ahern taught the industry's continuing education session on state law and wanted the enforcement report so she could give recurring problems more class time.
inGame: needs: the enforcement report and the course outline.

turns.pulledBy: An anonymized report identifies a recurring violation.
turns.what: The instructor adds a worked example.
turns.writesBack: The revised outline names that part of the law.

turns.pulledBy: The department has no report ready.
turns.what: The instructor uses the previous syllabus.
turns.writesBack: The unanswered request carries into course planning.
